prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a striking, futuristic dance scene featuring four women standing in a confident, synchronized pose. Each woman has a short, blunt-cut white bob hairstyle and wears oversized, pastel mint green outfits—loose t-shirts paired with matching baggy overalls. Their hands rest on their hips, elbows out, exuding attitude and unity. The background is a seamless, soft white gradient, creating a clean, minimalistic, and almost ethereal atmosphere. The lighting is bright and diffused, eliminating harsh shadows and giving the scene a high-key, editorial look. The color palette is dominated by cool tones—mint green and white—emphasizing a modern, avant-garde aesthetic. The camera angle is straight-on at eye level, with a shallow depth of field that keeps all four subjects in sharp focus, enhancing the sense of symmetry and cohesion. The overall style is reminiscent of high-fashion photography or a stylized music video, with a crisp, polished finish and a sense of dynamic energy frozen in a single, powerful moment.
